violations.description: General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. -Emloyee did not wash hands before donning gloves to box of cookies for a customer.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — ---Sanitizer sprays found with less than 100ppm chlorine solutions. -COS to ~100ppm Chlorine. Solutions were re-made while on-site.--In-use utensil was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing. -Scoops with handles in product of frappe powder and coffee ice cubes.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. -Case of donut boxes stored in contact with/below mesh bag of dirty linens.

Employee dressing areas and lockers. — --employees' clothing/possessions were in an area where contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single-service items may occur. -Employee lunch bag on top shelf in 2 door refrigerator. -Employee ear bud and bag of blueberries on top of same 2 door refrigerator. -Employee keys/wallet on prep table next to hand sink. *Ensure employee items are stored below and separate form food service items.
